about: Christopher J. Wilmes is an attorney who represents clients in the Chicago, Illinois area. Christopher Wilmes is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Christopher Wilmes chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Northwestern University School of Law and graduated in 2005. Christopher Wilmes passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2005.
He represents clients with Employment & Labor: Employee issues in Illinois. He also represents clients with Civil Rights and Consumer Law issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Christopher Wilmes has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
